purpose: Read-only paired trace-target variance and endpoint bootstrap decomposition on retained actual training buffers; no training or rescue of the closed GAE family
comparison: Recompute both registered traces with the identical stored rewards, values, reset masks and endpoint for each buffer; different source policies are not paired counterfactual policy outcomes
primary: Median within-buffer raw advantage population-variance ratio lambda1/lambda0.95 separately for each source arm; descriptive increase if above1, no promotion or statistical confidence claim
secondary: mean absolute endpoint critic contribution to lambda1 return
mean absolute raw-reward contribution to lambda1 return
mean absolute stored float32 reward-adjustment rounding contribution
endpoint_definition: Use raw rewards and terminal timeout value or last_values; true termination has zero tail. This is a finite-buffer identity, not an unbiased complete-return target. Include the separately measured discounted float32 reward-adjustment rounding residual so the identity is in float64 on stored values.
zero_denominator: null ratio; report count, never replace or drop silently
limits: No actual recurrent minibatch order or gradients are reconstructed
Raw trace variance does not establish normalized advantage variance or gradient noise
Different policies induce different reward/value paths
Bootstrap decomposition does not establish critic calibration
No lambda/gamma/optimizer/model/reward grid, extension, confirmation or checkpoint promotion follows from this audit
